title: One Federation suspended-negotiation handle
description: A handle the sender of an offer, counter-offer or query issues for the reply it awaits; the replying side echoes it unchanged in `inReplyTo.handle`. The handle is attacker-controlled input to its issuer. Wire form: JWE compact serialisation (RFC 7516) with direct AEAD encryption, `alg` `dir`, `enc` `A256GCM`, under a 256-bit key known only to the issuer. The issuer alone verifies it and enforces single use.

compact.description: BASE64URL(protected header) '..' BASE64URL(96-bit IV) '.' BASE64URL(ciphertext) '.' BASE64URL(128-bit tag). The encrypted-key part is empty because the content key is the issuer's direct key.

protectedHeader.description: Decoded JWE protected header; it is the AEAD additional authenticated data. No compression, no critical extensions, no other members.

claims.description: Decrypted plaintext (UTF-8 JSON). Binds the handle to sender and recipient identities, the chain, the suspended message's digest and a short validity window.

jti.description: Unique handle identifier; the issuer records it as spent on first successful use and keeps the record until `exp`.

iss.description: Issuing agent (sender of the suspended message).

sub.description: Person the issuing agent acts for.

aud.description: Agent expected to send the reply.

rcp.description: Person the replying agent must act for.

iat.description: Issue time, seconds since the Unix epoch.

exp.description: Expiry, seconds since the Unix epoch: equals the suspended message's `expiresAt` (truncated to seconds) and is at most 604800 seconds after `iat`.

st.description: Optional issuer-private resumption state. Confidential to the issuer; never interpreted by the replying side.
